author: Yu5yrrea
quote: GTA V had the guts to deliver genuinely brutal, unpredictable moments, such as Trevor using a train to kill someone. GTA VI must go beyond recycled shock value and deliver even more disturbing, creative, and unrestricted player interactions. After more than a decade, Rockstar has no excuse for playing it safe.
